title: Monday 28: Presidential candidates intensify campaign schedules
subtitle: In the final week of the election, the schedules of hopefuls for the Alvorada Palace accelerate significantly
excerpt: In the final week of campaigning, presidential candidates ramp up interviews and rallies nationwide on Monday (28).
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the final week of the political campaign, presidential candidates are intensifying their schedules with media interviews and rallies across the country. The 28th marked a turning point of acceleration in activities, with contenders appearing in different regions and participating in interviews aimed at reaching undecided voters.

Featured interviews

Candidates have been granting interviews to various media outlets, seeking to broaden the reach of their proposals and address questions from the public. This communication strategy has been adopted simultaneously by several competitors, reinforcing the competitiveness of the race.

Nationwide rallies

At the same time, the schedule includes in-person events in different states, featuring rallies, visits to communities, and meetings with local leaders. These public demonstrations are a routine part of the campaign in the final stretch, allowing candidates to connect with voters on their home turf.

The combination of interviews and rallies highlights the intensification of activities by presidential candidates in the final stage of the electoral process, demonstrating the typical dynamics of the last week of campaigning.

With information from Agência Brasil.
